def _pack_test_result(z):
    import numpy as np
    b = np.asarray(z[-1])
    shape = np.asarray((b.ndim, *b.shape), dtype=float)
    arrays = [np.asarray(x) for x in z]
    return np.concatenate([shape] + [x.reshape(-1).real.astype(float) for x in arrays] + [x.reshape(-1).imag.astype(float) for x in arrays])
